measurement_note: Size is n, the binary-string length. The legal 24-, 48-, and 96-character tiers span 4x. Each string has one run of n/2 zeroes followed by an alternating suffix, with no flips allowed, so the answer is n/2. The accepted method binary-searches the answer and scans all run lengths; a correct slower baseline tests candidate limits consecutively from one.
